# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 6 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_006_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 6

**6:1** The baby Mary grew stronger every day. When she was six months old, Anna set her down on the floor to test if she could stand on her own. The little girl took seven steps and walked straight back into her mother's arms. Anna scooped her up and said: "I swear before the living Lord — you will never touch this ground again until I take you to the temple."

**6:2** Anna transformed Mary's room into a kind of sanctuary and made sure nothing ritually impure ever crossed the threshold. She brought in only the young women of Israel who had kept themselves pure to look after the child.

**6:3** On Mary's first birthday, Joachim threw a great celebration, inviting everyone — priests, scribes, elders, and ordinary people of Israel. He presented the baby to the priests, and they prayed over her: "God of our fathers, bless this child! Give her a name that will be remembered in every generation." The people all answered: "Amen! So be it!"

**6:4** Joachim then brought her to the chief priests, who added their blessing: "O God Most High, look down on this little one. Give her the greatest blessing there is — one that nothing can ever surpass."

**6:5** Anna took the baby back to her room and nursed her. Then she lifted her voice in a song: "I will sing praise to the Lord my God, for he came to me and took away my shame! He has given me the fruit of his righteousness — a gift beyond all calculation. Who will go and tell the sons of Reuben? Anna has a baby at her breast! Hear it, all twelve tribes of Israel: Anna is nursing her child!"

**6:6** She tucked the baby in and went back out to her guests. When the feast ended, everyone went home full of joy, praising the God of Israel.
